quote:
Joey is one of my favorite humans. It's impossible to be around Joey and not be happy and optimistic about life. Our desks were close in the office, and I learned so much from Joey about data, math, Al, FinOps, Saas, and the world.
One thing I love about Joey is his curiosity. He wants to know how things work and is willing to put in the effort and data to solve complex problems.
In his time at Anglepoint, I've seen Joey grow from a new college grad to a trusted professional.
Because of his background in mathematics, development, and Al, he's got great breadth in the problems he works to solve.
I'd consider Joey a great fit for any role that requires solving very complex problems. He thrives on the challenge, and he does it all with a smile and an amazing attitude.

Joey was one of the first people at Anglepoint who made me feel welcome, and he quickly became both a friend and someone I had a lot of respect for professionally. His dedication to the company was hard to miss there were major initiatives where he would put in an incredible amount of time, sometimes working through multiple late nights, while still staying level-headed and focused on doing the job well.
What I appreciated most about Joey was that, despite that level of commitment, he was always kind, thoughtful, and easy to be around. We spent a lot of time talking about technology, high fantasy, and Dungeons & Dragons, and getting to know him outside of work made it even clearer how much he cares about his family, his friends, and the people around him. Any team would be lucky to have someone with his combination of dedication, intelligence, and character.
